notes:
BUILD 83
- Cars no longer get thrown onto their roofs by a slow or stuttering frame: the suspension is worked out in finer steps and a long frame is capped. Unclaimed cars already lying on their sides are stood back up when the game loads.
- Dinghy: the bow comes to a point instead of opening like a V, it rides higher so the sea is not in the boat with you, and its floor runs into the bow.
- The dinghy has an outboard to look after: pistons, spark plugs and a carburetor in its hatch, fuel in the tank, R to start it. New ones come fitted and fuelled; yours gets a part-worn engine and a little fuel.
- Wakes: foam peels off the bow and lies behind, spray at speed, and the propeller churns the water under the stern. Cars driving through water throw a wake as well.
- Your head only turns so far in a boat too.
- Low quality engine parts turn up in ordinary crates fairly often now.
